scripts.script:
--[[
rivals silent aim

working executers
Synapse Z and any paid executer

Doesnt work on
Xeno - maybe
Solora - confirmed
--]]
local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local youman = workspace.CurrentCamera 
local wow = require(storage.Modules.Utility)

local function rando() 
    local targets = {} 
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do 
        if v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then 
            table.insert(targets, v) 
        elseif v.Name == "HurtEffect" then 
            for _, p in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do 
                if p.ClassName ~= "Highlight" then table.insert(targets, p) end 
            end 
        end 
    end 
    return targets 
end 

local function thingidk(p)
    local h = p:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local root = p:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    return (h and root) and (h.Position + (root.Velocity * 0)) or (h and h.Position)
end

local function idk() 
    local target, min = nil, math.huge 
    local char = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character 
    if not char then return end 
    for _, p in ipairs(rando()) do 
        if p ~= char and p:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then 
            local pos = thingidk(p)
            local screen, vis = youman:WorldToViewportPoint(pos) 
            if vis then 
                local mag = (Vector2.new(youman.ViewportSize.X/2, youman.ViewportSize.Y/2) - Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y)).Magnitude 
                if mag < min then target, min = p, mag end 
            end 
        end 
    end 
    return target 
end 

local old = wow.Raycast 
wow.Raycast = function(...) 
    local args = {...} 
    if args[4] == 999 then 
        local target = idk() 
        if target then 
            local p = thingidk(target)
            if p then args[3] = p end
        end
    end 
    return old(unpack(args)) 
end
